Ballot Drop Box Locations

November 3, 2026, General Election

The Ballot Drop Box Location map identifies the locations throughout San Bernardino County where voters can drop off their Mail Ballots for the 2026 General Election.

  • View a full-screen map of the Ballot Drop Box Locations
  • View the List of Ballot Drop Box Locations [pdf]
    • Secure, outdoor Ballot Drop Boxes will be open by Monday, October 5 through 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3.
    • Staffed, indoor ballot boxes will be available beginning Monday, October 5, through Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, during regular business hours.
  • For more information on returning mail ballots, visit the Voting Options page.
